title: Identity-composition squares in higher operation coordinates
statement: Fix a six-functor operation datum S [def-fix-six-functor-datum] and a finite-type space X. At each integral, rational and common-stage coefficient category A, let U be the recorded identity pullback, T:A×A→A the recorded uncurried tensor and μ the components of projectionPullbackTensor [lem-sf-common-projection-pullback-tensor-compatibility] for the proper identity square. Let c_M:U(M)≅U(U(M)) be the supplied pullback compositor for identity followed by identity, precomposed with its equality transport. Then μ_{M,L} followed by T(c_M,c_L) = c_{T(M,L)} followed by U(μ_{M,L}) followed by μ_{U(M),U(L)} for all M,L in A. These are raw composition squares: neither an identity unit e nor an identity-unit tensor equation occurs in their hypotheses or conclusion.

proof.text: The fixed prime-to-characteristic setting makes the coefficient prime invertible on X. Expand projectionTransportTensorComparison by substitution along the recorded functor equalities; this aligns the HEq tensor-comparison normalizations with the supplied endpoints, retaining equality transports. For the integral stage use the functor and tensor comparison normalization fields to identify the specified comparison with the canonical completed one. pullProjection identifies the reduction comparisons with the actual projection-adjoint maps of good representatives. Their pullComposition equation and finitePullCompositionNormalization identify the supplied compositor with the canonical one on whole coherent quotient systems. Apply the canonical integral composition equation and use faithfulness of coherent integral system reduction to reflect the square. Retain all completion-unit factors; individual quotient equalities alone are not used as a faithfulness assertion.

The rationalization coefficient comparison preserves pullComposition. With the fixed tensor and pullback morphism normalizations, localize the integral square to obtain the rational square. Choose a common finite coefficient field for the common-stage objects and both arrows. commonStageComparison.pullComposition identifies the common compositor with the rational one, and commonProjectionPullbackTensorCompatibility identifies the tensor comparison. Apply ofHom to the rational equation. The transition cocycles make it independent of the chosen field. Transport identity squared to identity in each square.

theorem higherTensor_identityComposition (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) :
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      letI : IsProper (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left := by
        change IsProper (𝟙 X.obj.left)
        infer_instance
      let U := S.higher.integral.pull (𝟙 X)
      let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (S.higher.integralTensor X)
      let μ := fun M L ↦
        ((projectionPullbackTensor (S.higher.integralExchange
          (compactSupportProperSquare (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)))).hom.app M).app L
      let c : ∀ M, U.obj M ≅ U.obj (U.obj M) := fun M ↦
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (S.higher.integral.pull f).obj M)
          (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫
          (S.higher.integral.pullComposition (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).app M
      ∀ M L, μ M L ≫ T.map (Prod.mkHom (c M).hom (c L).hom) =
        (c (T.obj (M, L))).hom ≫ U.map (μ M L) ≫ μ (U.obj M) (U.obj L)) ∧
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      letI : IsProper (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left := by
        change IsProper (𝟙 X.obj.left)
        infer_instance
      let U := S.higher.rational.pull (𝟙 X)
      let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (S.higher.rationalTensor X)
      let μ := fun M L ↦
        ((projectionPullbackTensor (S.higher.rationalExchange
          (compactSupportProperSquare (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)))).hom.app M).app L
      let c : ∀ M, U.obj M ≅ U.obj (U.obj M) := fun M ↦
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (S.higher.rational.pull f).obj M)
          (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫
          (S.higher.rational.pullComposition (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).app M
      ∀ M L, μ M L ≫ T.map (Prod.mkHom (c M).hom (c L).hom) =
        (c (T.obj (M, L))).hom ≫ U.map (μ M L) ≫ μ (U.obj M) (U.obj L)) ∧
    (∀ X : SixFunctorSpace D,
      letI : IsProper (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).hom.left := by
        change IsProper (𝟙 X.obj.left)
        infer_instance
      let U := S.closure.commonStage.pull (𝟙 X)
      let T := Functor.uncurry.obj (S.closure.commonStageTensor X)
      let μ := fun M L ↦
        ((projectionPullbackTensor (S.closure.commonStageExchange
          (compactSupportProperSquare (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)))).hom.app M).app L
      let c : ∀ M, U.obj M ≅ U.obj (U.obj M) := fun M ↦
        eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (S.closure.commonStage.pull f).obj M)
          (Category.id_comp (𝟙 X)).symm) ≪≫
          (S.closure.commonStage.pullComposition (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X)).app M
      ∀ M L, μ M L ≫ T.map (Prod.mkHom (c M).hom (c L).hom) =
        (c (T.obj (M, L))).hom ≫ U.map (μ M L) ≫ μ (U.obj M) (U.obj L))
